Instant Quote builds custom software and AI tools for businesses, including e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, customer portals, and quoting engines. The Software Engineering Intern will develop and maintain client applications, build full-stack features, integrate APIs, monitor production systems, and participate in testing and code reviews.
Computer Software
Responsibilities
Build full-stack features for client web applications, from the database to the user interface
Maintain and improve existing client software, including bug fixes, performance improvements, dependency updates, and small feature requests
Develop parts of an inventory management system, including user permissions, stock tracking, change history, and reporting dashboards
Work on e-commerce storefronts connected to Shopify, including automated pricing and order syncing
Build and maintain client websites and customer-facing portals
Integrate third-party APIs and services
Monitor deployed applications and help resolve production issues
Write tests and take part in code reviews
